call_1_requirements.text: {"requirements":[{"paragraph":"3.2","text":"When two or more lamps are part of the same assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval shall be granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of this Regulation or of another Regulation."},{"paragraph":"3.2","text":"Lamps not satisfying any one of those Regulations shall not be part of such an assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps."},{"paragraph":"3.2.1","text":"If the devices submitted for approval in pursuance of paragraph 3.1. meet the requirements of this Regulation, approval shall be granted."},{"paragraph":"3.2.2","text":"An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3."},{"paragraph":"3.2.2","text":"The same Contracting Party shall not assign the same number to another type of device covered by this Regulation except in the case of an extension of the approval to a front fog lamp differing only in the colour of the light emitted by the lamp."},{"paragraph":"3.2.4.1","text":"The applicant shall submit sufficient documentation to prove the capability of the system to comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.22. of the UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.16. and 6.18. of UN Regulation No. 53 when correctly installed."},{"paragraph":"3.2.4.2","text":"The system shall be approved according to UN Regulation No. 10."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A driving-beam headlamp of Class A shall be marked with the symbol R, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YR."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class V (asymmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol V, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YV."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A driving-beam headlamp of Class B shall be marked with the symbol HR, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YHR."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class C (asymmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol C, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YC."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Auxiliary Driving-Beam of Class RA shall be marked with the symbol RA."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-C): basic passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol XC³."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-E): motorway passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol XCE1, 2."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-V): town passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol XCV3, 4."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-W): adverse weather passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol XCW3, 4."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System for vehicle of category L3 (Class AFS-C): basic passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol MXC³."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System for vehicle of category L3 (Class AFS-E): motorway passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol MXCE3, 4."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System for vehicle of category L3 (Class AFS-V): town passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol MXCV3, 4."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System for vehicle of category L3 (Class AFS-W): adverse weather passing-beam shall be marked with the symbol MXCW3, 4."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-R): driving-beam shall be marked with the symbol XR³."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class AS (symmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol C-AS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YC-AS."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class BS (symmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol C-BS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YC-BS."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class CS (symmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol WC-CS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YC-CS*."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A passing-beam headlamp of Class DS (symmetrical) shall be marked with the symbol WC-DS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YC-DS*."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A driving-beam headlamp of Class BS shall be marked with the symbol R-BS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YR-BS*."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A secondary driving-beam headlamp of Class CS shall be marked with the symbol WR-CS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YR-CS*."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A secondary driving-beam headlamp of Class DS shall be marked with the symbol WR-DS, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YR-DS*."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"An Adaptive driving-beam for vehicles of category L3 shall be marked with the symbol ADB, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YADB."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A front fog lamp of Class F3 shall be marked with the symbol F3, and, if the device is part of a matched pair, with the symbol YF3."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"A cornering lamp of Class K shall be marked with the symbol K."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"In the case of a single installation unit, the symbol \"XC\" or \"MXC\" shall be marked only once."},{"paragraph":"3.2.5. Table 1","text":"In the case of more installation units each providing one or more AFS function(s), each unit shall be marked with the symbol \"X\" or \"MX\" followed by the identification symbol(s) of the specific AFS function(s) provided."},{"paragraph":"3.3.1.1","text":"Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4. or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4."},{"paragraph":"3.3.1.1.1","text":"All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible."},{"paragraph":"3.3.1.2.1","text":"The value for \"a\" in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material and at least 8 mm on glass."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.1","text":"The approval mark shall be a circle surrounding the letter \"E\" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.2","text":"The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.2."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.3","text":"The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4","text":"The approval marking shall include symbol(s), according to Table 1, and, if applicable, the additional symbol(s) of paragraphs 3.3.2.4.1. to 3.3.2.4.9."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.1","text":"In the case of headlamps/AFS installation unit meeting left-hand traffic requirements only, the additional marking shall be a horizontal arrow pointing to the right of an observer facing the headlamp, i.e. to the side of the road on which the traffic moves."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.2","text":"In the case of headlamps/AFS installation unit designed to meet the requirements of both traffic systems with or without an appropriate adjustment of the setting of the optical unit or the light source(s) or light source module(s), the additional marking shall be a horizontal arrow with a head on each end, the heads pointing respectively to the left and to the right."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.3","text":"Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.4","text":"In the case of road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material, the group of letters \"PL\" shall be affixed near the symbols identifying the function(s)."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.5","text":"In the case of headlamps/AFS installation unit meeting the requirements of the driving-beam, an indication, placed near the circle surrounding the letter \"E\", of the maximum luminous intensity expressed by a reference mark (I'M), as defined in paragraph 5.1.4.2, shall be marked."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.5","text":"In the case of grouped or reciprocally incorporated driving-beam headlamps/AFS lighting unit, indication of the maximum luminous intensity of the driving-beams as a whole shall be expressed as specified for the reference mark near the circle surrounding the letter \"E\"."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.6","text":"In the case of AFS, a score above the letter(s) shall be marked indicating that the AFS function(s) is(are) provided by more than one installation unit on that side of the system."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.7","text":"In the case of AFS, in addition the symbol \"T\" shall be marked after the symbol(s) of all lighting function(s) and/or class(es) designed to comply with the respective bend lighting provisions, with said symbol(s) arranged together and leftmost to the symbol \"T\"."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.8","text":"On headlamps meeting the requirements of this Regulation in respect of the passing beam of Class C and the driving beam of Class B, \"HCR\" may be marked as the symbols for passing beam and driving beam."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.4.9","text":"On headlamps meeting the requirements of this Regulation in respect of both the passing beam and the driving beam and which have the same Classes BS, CS or DS, the letters \"CR-BS\" for Class BS headlamps or \"WCR-CS\" for Class CS headlamps or \"WCR-DS\" for Class DS headlamps shall be marked."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.5","text":"The approval number, the symbols and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter \"E\", or to the right or left of that letter."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.5","text":"The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter \"E\" and face the same direction."},{"paragraph":"3.3.2.5","text":"Unless otherwise specified, each symbol shall be marked individually in accordance with Table 1."},{"paragraph":"3.3.3.1","text":"The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available."},{"paragraph":"3.3.3.1","text":"The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4","text":"Road illumination functions or systems shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier, the trade name or mark of the applicant and the markings specified in paragraphs 3.3.4.1. to 3.3.4.8."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.1","text":"In the case of devices including a passing-beam designed to satisfy the requirements both of right-hand and of left-hand traffic, markings shall indicate the two settings of the optical unit on the vehicle or of the light source on the reflector; these markings shall consist of the letters \"R/D\" for the position for right-hand traffic and the letters \"L/G\" for the position for left-hand traffic."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.2","text":"In the case of lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, a marking shall indicate: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed; in the case where lamps have been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s); and/or (b) The specific identification code(s) of light source module(s) and (c) The rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.3","text":"In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light source modules, a marking shall indicate the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.4","text":"In the case of lamps with light source module(s), a marking on the light source module(s) shall indicate: (a) The trade name or mark of the applicant; (b) The specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters \"MD\" for \"MODULE\" followed by the markings as described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2. and, in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters; this identification code shall be shown in the drawings mentioned in paragraph 3.1.2.1.; the approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant; (c) The rated voltage or the range of voltage; in the case where the light-source module(s) is non-replaceable, it does not need to be marked."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.5","text":"In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.6","text":"In the case of AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS, and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) shall be placed near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.7.1","text":"In the case of a headlamp having additional lighting unit(s) for vehicles of categories L and T, the headlamps producing the principal passing-beam shall bear the specific identification code of the additional lighting unit(s) mentioned in paragraph 3.3.4.7.2.2."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.7.2","text":"Additional lighting unit(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant and the markings specified in paragraphs 3.3.4.7.2.1. and 3.3.4.7.2.2."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.7.2.1","text":"In the case of light source(s), the additional lighting unit(s) shall bear their category(ies); in the case where the lamp has been approved for the use of LED substitute light source(s) in the additional lighting unit(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s); and/or in the case of light source module(s), the rated voltage and rated wattage and the specific identification code(s) of the light source module(s)."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.7.2.2","text":"The additional lighting unit(s) shall bear the specific identification code(s) of the additional lighting unit(s); this marking shall be clearly legible and indelible; this specific identification code shall be comprised of starting letters \"ALU\" for \"Additional Lighting Unit\" followed by the approval marking without the circle and, in the case where several non-identical additional lighting units are used, additional symbols or characters shall follow; this specific identification code shall be shown in the drawings; the approval marking does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the additional lighting unit(s) is used, but both markings shall be from the same applicant."},{"paragraph":"3.3.4.8","text":"Road Illumination Devices may bear on their light-emitting surface a centre of reference as shown in Annex 11."},{"paragraph":"3.3.5.1","text":"The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp."},{"paragraph":"3.3.5.2","text":"In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened."},{"paragraph":"3.3.5.3","text":"If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body."},{"paragraph":"3.3.5.4","text":"In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device."},{"paragraph":"3.3.6.1","text":"In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, a single Unique Identifier or approval mark may be applied, provided that all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps satisfy the pertinent Regulation and that the requirements of paragraph 3.3.6.1. (a) to (c) are also fulfilled."},{"paragraph":"3.3.6.1","text":"In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark."},{"paragraph":"3.3.6.1","text":"In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked either on the appropriate light-emitting surface or in a group, in such a way that each lamp of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps may be clearly identified."}]}
